apiContracts: No API routes or server contracts change.
dataEntities: No new database entities or migrations; the existing imperial_language browser preference remains canonical.

migrationPlan.canonicalEntityReuse: Uses the existing browser-local interface language preference and existing locale dictionaries.
migrationPlan.backwardCompatibility: English SSR remains a no-JavaScript fallback; the client applies the saved interface language after shell boot.
migrationPlan.rollbackOrForwardRepair: Revert the homepage dictionary, text-node wrapper, skip-link labels and tests; no data repair is needed.

uiLifecycle.ssrBehavior: The existing server-rendered English homepage remains readable without JavaScript; no SSR renderer or HTML route changes.
uiLifecycle.clientBootBehavior: After SSR handoff or client rendering, exact static homepage copy is wrapped and translated using the saved locale. A child-list observer handles asynchronous page changes and disconnects when the app root is detached.

privacySecurity.ownerScoping: Creator-authored story titles, author names and dynamic catalog content are excluded from automatic translation.
privacySecurity.rateAndSizeLimits: No API or input limits change; language selection remains a finite fourteen-locale allowlist.

integration: Homepage static copy localization across SSR handoff and client fallback; search placeholder/accessible name translation; skip-link language and RTL direction; canonical/versioned bundle parity.
isolation: Dynamic creator-authored catalog content is excluded from automatic homepage copy translation.

stagingSteps: Pass exact-head architecture, route, source, schema, migration and Graphify workflows.
Verify English, Urdu, Arabic and Persian homepage rendering on mobile and desktop.
Verify dynamic story titles remain unchanged across language switches.

rollback.codeRollback: Revert the homepage localization dictionary, text-node localization helper, skip-link translations and regression tests.
rollback.dataRollbackOrForwardRepair: No database changes; restore the browser's interface locale through the existing language selector if needed.
monitoringSignals: Homepage copy and search accessibility labels match the selected locale.
Observer does not produce repeated DOM mutation loops.
Versioned 17.23.0 asset remains byte-identical to public/app.js.

collisionReview.duplicateRoutes: None; no route or API method is added.
collisionReview.sharedSurfaceOwners: Browser bundles remain experience-shell-owned; tests remain platform-quality-owned; package build wiring remains repository-operations-owned; ADR and contract remain platform-architecture-owned.

changeSummary: Ports fourteen-locale homepage copy and accessible skip-navigation labels onto the canonical 17.23 runtime, including search placeholder/accessible-name translation and Persian RTL, without replacing current SSR or translating creator content.
acceptanceCriteria: All 54 homepage core strings and 12 additional section strings have non-empty translations in all fourteen locales.
Homepage localization runs after both SSR handoff and client fallback.
Dynamic catalog story cards and creator-authored content are excluded from automatic translation.
The homepage search placeholder and accessible name follow the selected locale.
The skip-navigation link has a translation in all fourteen interface locales.
Urdu, Arabic and Persian set document direction to RTL.
The mutation observer does not repeatedly rewrite unchanged text and disconnects when the app root is detached.
